def backend.rangePred (es : List backend.Ent) (key : GoString) (i : Int) : Bool :=
  match es[i.toNat]? with
  | some e => !decide (backend.strLt e.fst key)
  | none => true

theorem backend.rangePred_mono (es : List backend.Ent) (key : GoString) (hs : backend.entsSorted es)
    : sort.IsMonoPred (backend.rangePred es key) ↑es.length

theorem backend.range_finish (L : List backend.Ent) (eb : GoString) (m lim : Nat) (ks vs : GoSlice)
    (kl vl : List GoSlice) (hall : ∀ (k : Nat) (x : backend.Ent), k < m → L[k]? = some x → decide
    (backend.strLt x.fst eb) = true) (hle : m ≤ lim) (hend : m = L.length ∨ (∃ x, L[m]? = some x ∧
    decide (backend.strLt x.fst eb) = false) ∨ m = lim) : ownSlice ks kl (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ownSliceCap
    GoSlice ks (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ownSlice vs vl (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ownSliceCap GoSlice vs (DFrac.own 1) ∗
    backend.slicesAre kl (List.map Prod.fst (List.take m L)) ∗ backend.slicesAre vl (List.map
    Prod.snd (List.take m L)) ⊢ backend.kvsOut ks vs (List.take lim (List.takeWhile (fun e => decide
    (backend.strLt e.fst eb)) L))

theorem backend.slicesAre_length (ss : List GoSlice) (bs : List GoString) : backend.slicesAre ss bs
    ⊢ ⌜ss.length = bs.length⌝
